      class Photo extends Object implements Serializable

      • Serialization Methods

        • readObject
          private void readObject(ObjectInputStream in) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
          Custom deserialization logic.

          After the photo's base data is deserialized, transient UI fields such as image and the thumbnail must be recreated manually.

          Parameters:
          in - the input stream
          Throws:
          IOException - if reading fails
          ClassNotFoundException - if class lookup fails
